claim: Distinct assigned target fields need not change native serving predictions. Common A limits projector-only query changes, but query changes requiring H motion still need not survive the native serving Jacobian or pool. Existing shared/I4 contrasts change native and projector ownership together.
domain: Symbolic interface algebra; nonzero Ah outside normalization clamp for local derivatives. No actual H, rank, gradients, predictions or model inspected.

notation.H: 128×n matrix of live pre-head hidden columns

identities.finite_common_A_realizability: For chosen unit query field U and fixed H: ∃positive s and A with AH=Udiag(s), equivalently ∃positive s with ker(H)⊆ker(Udiag(s)).
identities.common_query_rank_bound: rank([q_a])≤rank(A)≤128 in R300. Private A_m can have different ranges; union rank≤300. These are bounds, not measured ranks.
identities.common_metric_and_orientation: Query-query cosines depend on M=AᵀA; fixed-key alignment additionally depends on Aᵀk, so M alone is insufficient.

projector_only_witness: A nonzero tangent d perpendicular to range(A) has Aᵀd=0 but d hᵀ can be nonzero. A-only motion then changes auxiliary geometry with no direct auxiliary native gradient at that state; native serving is exactly independent of A at fixed native parameters.
nonabsorbable_case: Identical or positively collinear nonzero h cannot give distinct normalized q under one common A. Realizing their split requires H motion or another projection ownership; optimization may instead keep residual error. A desired query field of rank>128 is impossible for common A even after changing H.
serving_requirement: A first-order change in served probabilities requires Dθ p_served · δθ_native ≠0 for the actual optimizer-produced native motion. Hidden/output null directions, class-common logit shifts or route-pool cancellation can remove it; probability changes need not change argmax or improve quality.
limits: The full-loss optimum is not asserted to equal normalize(μ_Q).
With different K, both μ_p and μ_Q differ; isolated target mean is not the complete gradient.
Existence of A-only fitting does not show simultaneous Adam chooses it.
No arbitrary hidden-coordinate gauge is asserted realizable by the native architecture.
No present outcome, collapse, observed rank, acceptance or novelty conclusion.
finite_consistency_proof: Necessity: AH=Udiag(s) implies Udiag(s)v=0 whenever Hv=0. Sufficiency: define A(Hv)=Udiag(s)v on range(H); the kernel inclusion makes it well-defined, then extend the map to R128. Positive s ensure normalization gives the specified unit query field.
